race.comment: ALABAMA STATE (4) due for a change of luck and comes back a few levels for this. No match for the classy Decorum when sixth from the wide draw over this track and trip in BM88 class. Maps well and can finish over the top of these. QUEEN OF CLUBS (11) showed ability in stakes grade last time in and near her top now third up. Returned good closing splits when fifth over 1300m at this track from near last on the turn. Solid each way player. CALL ME SASSY (15) rewarded for her consistency when she gripped on late to score a narrow win over 1300m at this track in Midway class. Claim helps again from the tougher draw. Place best. VETWELVE (12) peaked on the run second up when fifth in this class. Well drawn and goes into the exotics.
